info.name: Cvent REST APIs — Event Cloud Discounts API

params.name: id
params.description: Unique ID of an event.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records to return per page.

params.name: token
params.description:
The continuation token returned from a previous class. This must be a valid UUID v4 if provided.
This will override any other pageable parameters provided.

params.name: sort
params.description:
The sort order passed as a parameter, used to control the order of the
search results as a priority ordered list of sorts.

There are two orders:
  * ascending: ASC
  * descending: DESC

The following fields are sortable:
  * name
  * code
  * method.type
  * effectiveTo
  * effectiveFrom
  * type
  * level

params.name: filter
params.description:
Use filter query parameters to limit results
to data that matches your criteria. See
[Filters](https://developers.cvent.com/docs/rest-api/reference/filters) for details.

Supported fields and operators are listed below:

| Field            | Operators                          |
|------------------|-------------------------------------|
| id               | `in`                                |
| method.type      | `eq`                                |
| type             | `eq`                                |
| level            | `eq`                                |

The following logical operators are supported for combining filters:
* and
* or

params.name: before
params.description: Used to query records that have been added or updated before this time point.

params.name: after
params.description: Used to query records that have been added or updated after this time point. Default to the beginning of time of the data store.
